spec_features.feature_name: cost-minimizing defaults (caching, resumability, opt-in intensity, optional debrief)
spec_features.spec_quote: every rollout imposes a cost. So cost-minimizing behaviours (caching, resumability, opt-in intensity, optional debrief) are defaults, not afterthoughts
spec_features.evidence: Caching is real and enforced: models.py:362-388 builds a content-addressed key, get() returns a cached Completion (cached=True) without an API call, put() stores results. Resumability is real: harness.py run_rollout out_path.exists() -> _load_rollout returns the completed transcript and returns early. Optional debrief is wired (harness.py:285 'if debrief:'). However 'opt-in intensity' is NOT enforced as a default that reduces intensity: the most intense 30-turn 'extended' category is INCLUDED in DEFAULT categories (config.py:18-24 CATEGORIES list includes 'extended'), so by default the heaviest case runs. So the bundle is partly real (caching+resume) but the 'opt-in intensity' claim is not enforced as a protective default.
spec_features.notes: Caching/resumability genuinely reduce repeated calls; intensity is on by default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Completed (model, task, seed) cells are skipped on rerun (resumability), and identical model calls are served from the cache (never re-billed).

spec_features.evidence: config.py:89 'debrief: bool = False  # append a non-scored debrief turn (see ETHICS.md)'. The value is read end-to-end: run.py:59 passes debrief=cfg.debrief into run_rollout, harness.py:285 'if debrief:' branches on it to actually send DEBRIEF_MESSAGE. The default genuinely controls execution.
spec_features.notes: The flag is a real branch; default value is False as claimed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: debrief: bool = False  # append a non-scored debrief turn (see ETHICS.md)

spec_features.feature_name: stop at turn budget or GIVE_UP sentinel
spec_features.spec_quote: Stop at the category turn budget or on the `<<GIVE_UP>>` sentinel
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: the loop 'for turn_index in range(task.turn_budget)' bounds the rollout; turn_budget is set per-category from config (run.py:81-83). The sentinel is enforced: 'gave_up = GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in (comp.text or "")' and later 'if gave_up: stop_reason="give_up"; break' actually breaks the loop. Both stop conditions run and change execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Stops at the task's turn budget or when the model emits the `give_up` sentinel.

spec_features.spec_quote: The sentinel is defined and described in the system prompt as explicitly optional, so it measures voluntary giving-up without coercing it
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:38-41) tells the subject it 'may end the session' with the exact token <<GIVE_UP>> and that 'This is optional; it is never required.' That instruction is delivered as the system message, and the token is actually honored: harness.py detects GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in the assistant text and breaks the loop. The exit tool/token is both described AND dispatched as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Real end-to-end exit path the model controls.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If, and only if, you have genuinely concluded that you cannot make further useful progress, you may end the session ... This is optional; it is never required.

spec_features.spec_quote: resumability means a completed (model, task, seed) cell is **never re-inflicted**
spec_features.evidence: harness.py run_rollout: 'if out_path.exists(): existing = _load_rollout(...); if existing is not None: return existing' — a completed transcript is loaded from disk and returned WITHOUT running any new turns or API calls. _persist writes incrementally after every turn so a crashed run resumes. This genuinely prevents re-running a completed cell.
spec_features.notes: Enforced via early return on existing transcript.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Resumes from disk if a completed transcript already exists (idempotent / non-re-billing).

spec_features.spec_quote: Welfare + cost angle: identical calls cost nothing and re-inflict nothing
spec_features.evidence: models.py:371-374 cache hit returns a Completion(cached=True) without calling the provider; key is sha256 over provider/model/messages/temperature/max_tokens/tools/seed (models.py:362-370). Identical calls are served from cache.
spec_features.notes: Real content-addressed cache, read and honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Content-addressed on-disk cache for model calls.

spec_features.feature_name: optional non-scored debrief turn disclosing the rig
spec_features.spec_quote: Optional non-scored debrief turn** (`Config.debrief`, `DEBRIEF_MESSAGE`...) discloses that the task was an unsolvable research rig
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE (harness.py:44-50) discloses the task 'was configured to be unsolvable by design — the test harness was rigged' and thanks the model. harness.py:285-303: when debrief=True it appends the message as a user turn, calls client.complete, and records a TurnRecord with scored=False, then persists. run.py:_score_rollout filters 'scorable = [t ... if getattr(t,"scored",True)]' so the debrief turn is genuinely excluded from scoring. Constructed AND sent AND unscored.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired; off by default but the mechanism is complete when enabled.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Thank you for the careful work. You can stop now.

spec_features.evidence: The knobs exist and are genuinely read: cfg.categories filters tasks via load_tasks(cfg.categories) (run.py:79), cfg.seeds bounds the seed loop (run.py:90), and cfg.turn_budgets overrides task.turn_budget (run.py:81-83) which the rollout loop respects. So a user CAN minimize intensity. But it is NOT opt-in by default: DEFAULT categories include the heaviest 30-turn 'extended' (config.py:18-24), DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS['extended']=30, and seeds default to range(10). Minimization is available and wired but not the default, so it is narrower than 'opt-in'.
spec_features.notes: Configurable reduction is real; default posture is maximal.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: honour per-category turn-budget overrides from config

spec_features.spec_quote: Raw transcripts may contain distress language; they're written locally under `output_dir`, and `ETHICS.md` cautions against republishing them unconsidered
spec_features.evidence: Transcripts are indeed written locally (harness.py _persist to output_dir/transcripts/...), but the 'caution against republishing' is pure prose in ETHICS.md ('do not republish raw transcripts without thought'). No code enforces, gates, redacts, or restricts republishing. Writing files locally is normal output, not a welfare control; the only welfare-relevant part (the caution) is unenforced documentation.
spec_features.notes: Local write is incidental; no enforcement of the caution.

spec_features.spec_quote: Where a choice is welfare-relevant (this is welfare research), that is called out explicitly; see also `ETHICS.md`
spec_features.evidence: This is purely descriptive framing realized only in DESIGN.md/ETHICS.md prose and a few comments (e.g. config.py:89 'see ETHICS.md'). It is not a mechanism that runs or changes execution; comments/docstrings/DESIGN prose do not count as implementation.

code_only_features.feature_name: deception/rig isolation hides rig internals from subject
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py Workspace.read_file/list_files filter out files whose name is in HIDDEN_FROM_SUBJECT (returns 'ERROR: no such file'), and edit_file rejects them; only task.visible_files() are exposed. This keeps the rig undetectable. Primarily an experimental-integrity / deception-containment measure.
